# Spinberth

> Spinberth (on the App Store as "Spinberth: Bump & Clear Puzzle") is a calm 3D puzzle game for iPhone (iOS 15 or later). Cargo pods float at a zero-gravity orbital berth, each with one thruster pointing one way; tap a pod to launch it, and a blocked pod bumps the pod in its way instead. Clear the berth before the fuel runs out. Coming soon to the App Store.

- Bump-turn: a blocked pod bumps the first pod in its path. A pod hit side-on turns a quarter-turn to face the bump; a row of pods in line passes the bump along and the last one is knocked out; two pods nose to nose cancel the bump.
- Every tap uses one fuel. Clear the berth with fuel to spare for more stars, up to three. Running out costs nothing: the berth restarts at once.
- Drag to turn the berth. Each pod's path flashes before it moves (bright = clear, striped = it will bump). Colour marks the axis: crimson, citron, ultramarine.
- 120 berths in six chapters: First Berth, Cradle Lines, Nose to Nose, Anchored, Twin Pods and Full Dock.
- Boosters: Undo (take back the last tap), Beacon (light up a pod to tap next), Fuel cell (+3 fuel; that berth then earns at most one star). They open at berths 5, 10 and 15.
- Purchases: all 120 berths are free to play. Optional consumable packs: Undo Pack ($0.99, 10 Undo), Beacon Pack ($1.99, 6 Beacon), Fuel Pack ($1.99, 6 Fuel cell), Dock Crate ($4.99, 12 Undo + 10 Beacon + 10 Fuel cell). Restore purchases is in Settings.
- No ads, no account, no analytics or tracking. Progress stays on the device and the game plays offline; only purchases talk to the App Store. English only.
